title: Discovery of ganoderic acid A (GAA) PROTACs as MDM2 protein degraders for the treatment of breast cancer.
authors: Li, Yan; Li, Guangyu; Zuo, Chenwei; Wang, Xiaolin; Han, Fang; Jia, Yi; Shang, Hai; Tian, Yu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究GAA PROTAC降解MDM2蛋白治疗乳腺癌，核心是蛋白-小分子降解剂与药物活性，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与课题无关。
abstract: Breast cancer is one of the most common female malignant tumors, with triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) being the most specific, highly invasive, metastatic and associated with a poor prognosis. Our previous study showed that the natural product ganoderic acid A (GAA) has a certain affinity for MDM2. In this study, two series of novel GAA PROTACs C1-C10 and V1-V10 were designed and synthesized for the treatment of breast cancer. The antitumor activity of these compounds was evaluated against four human tumor cell lines (MCF-7, MDA-MB-231, SJSA-1, and HepG2). Among them, V9 and V10 showed stronger anti-proliferative effects against breast cancer cells, and V10 showed the best selectivity in MDA-MB-231 cells (TNBC), which was 5-fold higher than that of the lead compound GAA. Preliminary structure-activity analysis revealed that V-series GAA PROTACs had better effects than C-series, and the introduction of 2O-4O PEG linkers could significantly improve the antitumor activity. Molecular docking, surface plasmon resonance (SPR), cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), and Western blot researches showed that both V9 and V10 could bind with MDM2, and degrade the protein through the ubiquitin-proteasome system. Molecular dynamics simulation (MD) revealed that V10 is a bifunctional molecule that can bind to von Hippel-Lindau (VHL) at one end and target MDM2 at the other. In addition, V10 promoted the upregulation of p21 in p53-mutant MDA-MB-231 cells, and induced apoptosis via down-regulation of the bcl-2/bax ratio and the expression of cyclin B1. Finally, in vivo experiments showed that, V10 also exhibited good tumor inhibitory activity in xenografted TNBC zebrafish models, with an inhibition rate of 27.2% at 50 mug/mL. In conclusion, our results suggested that V10 has anti-tumor effects on p53-mutant breast cancer in vitro and in vivo, and may be used as a novel lead compound for the future development of TNBC.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌是最常见的女性恶性肿瘤之一，其中三阴性乳腺癌（triple-negative breast cancer, TNBC）最具特异性，侵袭性强、易转移且预后较差。我们前期研究表明，天然产物灵芝酸A（ganoderic acid A, GAA）对MDM2具有一定的亲和力。本研究设计并合成了两个系列的新型GAA PROTACs C1-C10和V1-V10，用于乳腺癌的治疗。针对四种人肿瘤细胞系（MCF-7、MDA-MB-231、SJSA-1和HepG2）评估了这些化合物的抗肿瘤活性。其中，V9和V10对乳腺癌细胞表现出较强的抗增殖作用，且V10在MDA-MB-231细胞（TNBC）中显示出最佳选择性，其活性比先导化合物GAA高5倍。初步构效分析表明，V系列GAA PROTACs的效果优于C系列，且引入2O-4O PEG连接子可显著提高抗肿瘤活性。分子对接、表面等离子体共振（surface plasmon resonance, SPR）、细胞热位移分析（cellular thermal shift assay, CETSA）和Western blot研究表明，V9和V10均能与MDM2结合，并通过泛素-蛋白酶体系统降解该蛋白。分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics, MD）揭示，V10是一种双功能分子，其一端可结合von Hippel-Lindau（VHL），另一端靶向MDM2。此外，V10在p53突变的MDA-MB-231细胞中促进p21上调，并通过下调bcl-2/bax比值和细胞周期蛋白B1的表达诱导凋亡。最后，体内实验表明，V10在异种移植TNBC斑马鱼模型中同样表现出良好的肿瘤抑制活性，在50 μg/mL浓度下抑制率为27.2%。总之，我们的结果表明，V10在体外和体内对p53突变乳腺癌具有抗肿瘤作用，并可能作为未来TNBC开发的新型先导化合物。
